Select molecules reported in document CHEMBL4052680. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4052680'. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to fetch canonical_smiles. Order by molecule_chembl_id.
